marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind light becoming northwest 15 knots early this evening then
diminishing to light near midnight. Wind increasing to southeast 20 near noon
Thursday. Scattered showers this afternoon and this evening. Fog
patches dissipating near noon. Fog patches reforming Thursday
afternoon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 Thursday
evening.<br/>
